answer: Each identity pledges a share of future earnings to a commons pool: when an unrelated counterparty pays for verified work, that share is withheld at payment time and locked for six epochs. Like timber, standing grows over seasons, and each stream leaves a pigment trace to the address that earned it. If an identity is proven a duplicate, its pledged streams are forfeited and linked addresses flagged at dawn audits. A farm needs one independent income stream per fake, each earning from different clients over months; detection burns them all, so puppets multiply revenue at risk.
